summary.content:
Today's selection covers 81 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 52 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI ‘teammate’ just outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Hackers infect Android car head units with proxy botnet malware
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 11 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.title: Hackers infect Android car head units with proxy botnet malware
top.description: A supply-chain attack targeting Android-based car head units is using a legitimate device-update app to spread malware that enlists compromised devices in a proxy botnet or uses them for ad fraud. [.....

top.description: OpenAI is calling for California to strengthen SB 53, an AI safety bill that the company previously opposed.

top.title: AI Slop Is Everywhere. Spotify, LinkedIn and Others Have Had Enough.
top.description: Spotify, LinkedIn and others are trying to dig out of a digital sewage heap full of low-quality content made with artificial intelligence.

top.description: The new AI security controls follow the Hugging Face incident last month, though many of these additions perhaps should have been in place prior to the frontier models escaping.
